q: A 25 year old female came to hospital for MTP (Medical termination of Pregnancy). She informed the doctor that it was an unplanned pregnancy, as she and her partner were always using contraception. O/E, period of gestation was found to be 24 weeks. What is the legal aspect?
o: MTP can be performed as she is an adult
MTP can be performed if both partners are giving the consent
MTP can be performed upto 24 weeks of pregnancy
e:
• Pregnancy can be terminated upto 24 weeks, only in cases of survivors of rape
• In case of failure of contraceptive in a woman of her partner, MTP can be done only upto 20 weeks.
MTP ACT 2021
• Opinion of one RMP for MTP: upto 20 weeks
• Opinion of two RMP for MTP: 20-24 weeks
• Pregnancy can be terminated upto 24 weeks, only in cases of survivors of rape
• In case of failure of contraceptive in a woman of her partner, MTP can be done only upto 20 weeks.
• MTP can be done even after 24 weeks, in case of substantial foetal abnormalities diagnosed by a medical board.
• Note: MTP can be performed at any time, if it immediately necessary to save the life of pregnant women.
